Global TH1100-PLDUM-AL blank pull plate for bore holes

text.description_html:
Exit Device Pull Plate

This Pull Plate Trim for Global Stainless Steel Rim Exit Device, TH1100EDTBAR Touch Bar Exit Devices, 44 Inch Rim Exit Devices and other manufactures Panic Devices. Packaged with mounting hardware.

Used to cover a pre drilled bore hole. This pull plate is used when installing a Panic Device on doors with pre drilled bore holes. To be used were an exterior door pull is desired for entry if the panic device is dogged. Can also be used on Non pre drilled doors.

Also available: Pull Plate with Lock Cylinder

Features for Global TH1100-PLDUM-AL Pull Plate

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Pull Plate Height: 8"
  • Pull Plate Width: 3"
  • Pull Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Includes Sex Bolts
